title: Green Hell
notes: Started from Highball's library (`steam.exe -silent -applaunch 815370`), played for 12 minutes 13 seconds (12:21:11 to 12:33:24): the opening jungle, a climb down to the river, and the first campfire spot. All four captures are 1920x1080, because the game puts the display into exclusive full screen at 1920x1080@120 (`info: Setting display mode: 1920x1080@120` in the launch log) rather than running on the panel's HiDPI desktop. Frame rate on the Metal HUD (bottom left): 42.78 fps in the dense jungle, 59.94 and 53.19 around the river, 52.61 in the settings screen. The 59.94 is the game's own limit, not headroom — its 图像 screen has `帧率限制` set to 60 FPS — so the ceiling in the light spots is a setting while the 42-53 in the heavier spots is the GPU. It never stuttered or hitched and nothing in the game misbehaved. The game's own graphics settings, from its options screen, for context: 质量 中等, 抗锯齿 SMAA, 纹理质量 中等, 视野 75.0, 阴影距离 and 物体绘制距离 both around the middle of their sliders, 垂直同步 关闭, 显示模式 独占全屏, 分辨率 1920x1080, 刷新率 120 Hz. Unity 2021.2.20f1 (Mono), 64-bit, D3D11 (feature level 11_1). DXMT loaded and did not fall back to wined3d. No mods: there is no `steamapps/workshop/content/815370`. `Player.log` carries no exceptions at all, and the session ended cleanly. For the page: no romanisation needed — the store name is already English (`Green Hell`, Creepy Jar, 5 Sep 2019).
